Bihar CM Vows Zero Tolerance on Human Trafficking, Focuses on Jobs

Bihar's Chief Minister, Samrat Choudhary, has stated the state government is implementing a zero-tolerance policy against human trafficking. He emphasized that creating job opportunities and enhancing skills are key strategies to combat this crime. The Chief Minister made these remarks in his capacity as the head of the Bihar government.
